command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = "agent-work"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)"
test -f AGENTS.md
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess
remote = subprocess.check_output(['git','remote','get-url','origin'], text=True).strip()
valid = {
    'https://github.com/MichalMatu/MatrixHub.git',
    'git@github.com:MichalMatu/MatrixHub.git',
    'ssh://git@github.com/MichalMatu/MatrixHub.git',
    'ssh://git@ssh.github.com:443/MichalMatu/MatrixHub.git',
}
if remote not in valid:
    raise SystemExit(f'unexpected MatrixHub origin: {remote}')
PY
echo MATRIXHUB_AGENT_SMOKE_V3_OK
